author: lapide
title: The Great Commentary: S. John's Gospel
edition: The Great Commentary of Cornelius à Lapide, translated by Thomas W. Mossman, assisted by various scholars, Vols. V (S. John's Gospel, chaps. I to XI, 3rd ed.) and VI (chaps. XII to XXI, 4th ed.). Edinburgh: John Grant, 1908; archive.org scans "greatcommentaryo05lapi" and "greatcommentaryo06lapi" (Princeton Theological Seminary Library), djvu OCR text
translation: English translation by Thomas W. Mossman and others (first published 1876-1887; these are the 1908 Edinburgh printings). Mossman translated John 1-6, James Bliss chapters 7-10, S. J. Eales chapter 11, a Mr. Macpherson chapter 13, and Mossman and Bliss the rest.

rights.worldwide: to confirm: Mossman died in 1885; the death dates of James Bliss, S. J. Eales and Mr. Macpherson (life + 70 years)

notes: Vol. VI is at https://archive.org/details/greatcommentaryo06lapi. Mossman's translation abridges the Latin in places, as his notice to the reader says. Each excerpt opens Lapide's note on a verse ("Ver. 19. — ...", or the lemma where the note has no verse mark), up to about 350 words, cut at sentence ends; a verse whose mark the OCR garbles is left out. The OCR turns Lapide's Greek and Hebrew into noise: a sentence holding it is left out and marked " ... ". Misreadings of italics ("7vas", "ivhen", "/ say") are corrected in library/corrections/lapide.json, each pair a word the scan misreads once that the same scan prints correctly many times. Headings are Lapide's lemmas, empty where the OCR garbles them.
